# Manual: https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/Parameters.html#Subscript-Flags
# Issue #540: dquote_parse counts the flag argument's `(` too, so the `)` in
# `${y:-)}` does not close it and the subscript never closes. zsh -f -n
# accepts this at top level and in a function body; running it reports:
# invalid subscript.
print $x[(r)a[(b]${y:-)}()]
